_comment: Which cards get a holo foil and which effect they use. Cards of a rarity in foil_rarities get a foil unless their script sets foil= itself. The first rule that matches picks the effect; fields in a rule are AND-ed: sets (exact codes), set_regex, rarity (names). Effects are FoilEffects names. Era rules marked 'guess' are not confirmed against the original game; change them freely and restart. foil_extra gives a foil to extra rarities in matching sets (here: plain Rares from Scarlet & Violet on, which are all holo). styles forces a mask style (full = whole card face, window = art box, reverse, radiant = plaid body + etched subject) by set_regex / sets / rarity / subtype; the first match wins. number_above maps set code -> printed card count; the rule only matches cards numbered above it. Cards with no match use full for V-type and secret rarities and window otherwise. Each rule can also set mask_texture = a gradient name from ptcgo/server/foil_data (e.g. SunBeam, GoldEtch, SilverEtch, SwSecret, Celebration, shineRepeater03) so the mask follows that gradient's shape instead of the effect's own; effect decides the colours. Colours: BWETCH = gold, XYETCH = silver, FLATSILVER = silver, SUNLAVA = fiery, SVHOLO = blue/rainbow bands, SWSECRET = glitter rainbow. After editing a rule delete ~/ptcgo-revival/ptcgo/assets/bundleCache/foil_masks and restart so masks rebuild.

foil_extra._note: every Rare is holo from Scarlet & Violet on
BREAK cards are stored as plain Rare, so flag them by subtype
safety net: Radiant Pokemon always foil

styles._note: Radiant: plaid over the card body, etched lines on the Pokemon only (matches the real cards)
rule-box Pokemon: foil over the whole face

Illustration Rares / Special Illustration Rares are numbered past a set's printed count and the data has no rarity for them, so cards numbered above the count listed here get full coverage. Plain Rares stay art-box. Add or fix a set's printed count here (ME2PT5 and later are not listed).
